news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Market cap is less than US$10m (₹138.4m market cap, or US$1.48m). news.title: 7NR Retail Limited Announces Resignation of Avantinath Anilkumar Raval as Non-Executive and Non- Independent Director, with Effect from the Closure of Working Hours of 14 April, 2026
news.body: The board of directors of 7NR Retail Limited at its meeting held on 14 April 2026, Considered and took note of the resignation of Mr. Avantinath Anilkumar Raval (DIN No.- 07686783) from the post of Non-Executive Director of the Company with effect from the closure of working hours of 14th April, 2026 due to personal reasons and other professional commitments.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.037 (vs ₹0.037 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.037 (in line with 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹25.6m (up 412% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.03m (flat on 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.0% (down from 21% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 35% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 21% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.17 (vs ₹0.20 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.17 (up from ₹0.20 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹54.1m (up 171% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹4.69m (up ₹10.4m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 8.7% (up from net loss in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 16% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 24% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.
